# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Linux x86 support removal**

## Highlights

The upcoming release removes native assets for 32-bit x86 Linux.

## Breaking Changes

- **Migrate Linux x86 deployments before upgrading** — Native builds and NuGet package entries for Linux x86 are being removed. Applications deployed on 32-bit x86 Linux must move to a supported architecture before upgrading to this release. ([#5784](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5784))
